prompt: Add a SinkNodeMetrics registry to Kafka Streams next to the existing node-level metrics classes, following the conventions of the processor node metrics class. It needs three DEBUG-level node sensors: records-sent (invocation rate and count), bytes-sent (rate of sum and sum), and send-latency (avg and max). Don't write tests or change existing files.
